content:
Alongside the ongoing pre-order discount on the new Apple TV 4K, Amazon is still shipping HomeView even faster than Apple, and we still have AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off. Just be sure to check out the all-time low on Apple’s 2026 all-glyph Magic Keyboard and the ongoing M6 Mac mini deals at nearly $150 off before you scope out the launch deal on the new Baseus PicoGo Air AM72 ultra-slim Qi2 power bank for iPhone Duo and the all-time low on the 2026 HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock. Everything else awaits below.

Land a solid deal on Apple’s best buds to pair with your Duo: AirPods Pro 3 now $50 off

It has been all about Amazon’s early pre-order discounts on Apple’s brand new HomeView (it is also still shipping the next-gen Apple TV 4K much sooner than Apple can), but this morning we are circling back to the wonderful AirPods Pro 3. You can still score Apple’s best AirPods at $50 off via Amazon.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)

New Apple TV 4K still discounted and arriving as soon as release day at Amazon

Note: Delivery times are now starting to slip in select regions.

WWhile even Amazon’s delivery times for the new HomeView are starting to slip, it is still offering the new next-gen Apple TV 4K with a discount and release day delivery (at the time of writing).

While this isn’t going to be the case for all locations across the country, several folks around here are still seeing day 1 delivery for the new Apple TV 4K at Amazon.

Apple’s delivery times are still sitting at between November 27 and December 4, but Amazon is charging less and delivering them starting at November 13 (release day) still.

  • NEW Apple TV 4K $289 (Reg. $299)

As we mentioned above, it is likely only be a matter of time before Amazon’s Apple TV 4K deliveries start to get delayed, much like some of its HomeView listings. If you are looking to land the new Apple streaming device as soon as possible, you might want to get in there as soon as possible too – Amazon is still charging less than Apple and delivering them quicker.

You can just score the new Apple TV Siri Remote (4th generation) for $59 and upgrade your existing Apple TV setup for a whole lot less – it is still set to deliver on November 13 as of right now.

Amazon still shipping HomeView even faster than Apple as delivery dates start slipping into December

Some of the deliveries times from Apple on its new HomeView have slipped right into December at this point. As of today, we are just starting to see the same happen over on Amazon, but you can still score one from there much faster than Apple in most regions of the country (as of the time of writing).

The new HomeView lands with a $299 list price and is now available for pre-order ahead of the November 13 release date. At this point, there is still a chance to land one on release day from Amazon, but only on select colors:

One thing to keep in mind here is that Apple is still shipping the Rose Pink model on release day, and Amazon is no longer able to ship the still discounted pink model on time to some regions.

That said, Amazon has the popular Silver model listed as arriving well ahead of Apple’s delivery date – we are seeing it landing as soon as November 22, compared to the well into December dates we are seeing on the Apple site. ite.

Now that Amazon’s delivery dates have begun to slip past launch day, it is a good indication that it is quickly going to become increasingly difficult to land one within the first week of release. If you are looking to score one as soon as possible, now is the time to do it, especially if you’re after the popular Silver model.

Apple’s 2026 all-glyph Magic Keyboard is sitting at the Amazon all-time low (Nearly 20% off)

Alongside the up to $150 price drops on the new M6 Mac mini, another one of the more impressive fall Prime Day hangover deals still live, that also happens to be the perfect companion piece, is Apple’s new Magic Keyboard – it is sitting at the Amazon all-time low right now.

Amazon is now offering the 2026 Apple Magic Keyboard down at $79.99 shipped.

This is the new all-glyph model in its base and most affordable capacity that regularly carries a $99 list price. This deal knocks nearly 20% off to deliver the lowest we have tracked since release a couple months back.

Deals on official Magic accessories have historically been somewhat rare, so we wanted to circle back on this deal while it was up for grabs. You’re effectively looking at the fall Prime Day price here today, it just happens to still be live and ready for the taking.

Apple’s 2026 M6 Mac mini is nearly $150 off right now

One of the more impressive hangover Apple deals we are still tracking from back during the fall Prime Day event is still live – the new 2026 M6 Mac mini at up to nearly $150 off.

This is not some slight early launch discount or $50 off or something, but rather a proper and rather impressive fall Prime Day deal that is somehow still live. The entry level model did drop down another $11 for a short time in the middle of the Prime Big Deal Days event in early October, but we are still tracking its initial Prime deal price as well as a near $150 off the mid-range 16GB/512GB config.

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (Reg. $1,099)

While the price of the Mac mini went up this generation, it is still one of the best bang for your buck options in the current-generation Mac lineup if you ask me, and one I have been leveraging for my day to day for years.

While I am yet to pull the trigger on the new Mac mini with hopes of seeing that 24GB model drop significantly lower, it’s hard to imagine we see any of them at much more than $150 off through 2026. It could happen, and Black Friday is around the corner, but $150 off a, more or less, brand new Mac is quite impressive if you ask me.

We just spotted a new Amazon all-time low on the 2026 HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD Enclosure at $100 off the list price.

You’re looking at a proper 2026 model Thunderbolt 5 Dock solution from Hyper, complete with an SSD enclosure, 120Gbps action, and multi-display support at the lowest price we have tracked since release here.

The brand’s official Amazon storefront is now offering its HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD Enclosure at $299.99 shipped. Regularly $400, this is a straight up $100 price drop, $20 under our previous mentions, and a new Amazon all-time low. 

Baseus just launched the nicest Qi2 iPhone Duo MagSafe power bank yet [Launch deal]

While your existing MagSafe power banks might still work with the iPhone Duo, almost all of them will likely hang off the bottom because of the foldable’s shorter form factor. You’re going to need a new one that’s purpose-built for the iPhone Duo, like this new Baseus PicoGo Air AM72 ultra-slim Qi2 power bank – now up for grabs via the brand’s official storefront with a launch deal at $59.99 shipped. Be sure to enter promo code PICOGO72F at checkout to see the discounted price. This is a brand-new model that just debuted at $80, so you’re saving $20 right out of the gate. Head below for a closer look and more details.

One of my personal favorite charging stations is on sale again folks – the Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger. Now $50 off the list price, you can now score it within a few bucks of the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon.

The official Anker Amazon storefront is now offering its Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger down at $99.73 shipped.

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Score a 2-pack of 45W USB-C chargers for FREE when you buy this 140W Smart Display model at $63
  • Elgato’s Facecam 4K Studio Webcam with DSLR-like controls hits one of its lowest prices at $160
  • Baseus’ new Spacemate RD1 docks hit Amazon with smart displays, up to 140W charging, and 35% off launch deals
  • Sharge’s must-see metal power bank with smart display is $50 off (Amazon low)
  • UGREEN’s all-new pocket-sized Qi2.2 25W MagFlow Pro travel charger is 50% off right now at $30 low
  • UGREEN’s all-new 10,000mAh Smart Display power bank hits new low at $60
  • Sharge’s 140W 20,000mAh and 170W 24,000mAh power banks sit $5 above Prime Day pricing starting from $80

One of the best gaming TVs is $1,000 off: LG C6 OLED hits Amazon low ahead of GTA VI and Zelda release

Two of the biggest game releases in recent memory are about to hit – Grand Theft Auto VI and Zelda Ocarina of Time remake – and one of the best 2026 gaming TVs just hit its best price ever. You can now score the LG 55-inch OLED evo AI C6 4K Smart TV down at $999.99 – that’s $1,000 under the 2026 launch price and the larger sizes are marked down as well.

Amazon is now offering the 55-inch LG Class LG OLED evo AI C6 4K Smart TV down at $999.99 shipped. This model debuted at $2,000 earlier this year, still carries that list price directly from LG, and is now sitting at the Amazon all-time low.

These TechWoven-style iPhone 18 Pro and Duo cases are up to $100 less than Apple’s, deals from $17

We are tracking some discounts on Apple’s TechWoven iPhone 18 Pro cases, but this morning we taking a look at these much more affordable knock-off models from Mkeke. Nothing is going to replace the real thing, but if you’re not looking to spend upwards of $129, these models might be worth a look. The iPhone 18 Pro/Max models start from just $17 Prime shipped and the new Duo woven models start at under $30.

  • Mkeke iPhone Duo Woven Case from $30 (Reg. $36)
  • Mkeke iPhone 18 Pro Woven Case from $19 (Reg. $30)
  • Mkeke iPhone 18 Pro Max Woven Case from $17 (Reg. $30)
